messages:
amanda: Heads-up — we need to pick where the compatibility shim lives for the 'slim' API cohort cutover. Quick summary: two options — edge adapter vs runtime adapter. Proposal and tradeoffs below, please chime in.

josh: Edge adapter is simpler for opt-in cohorts and lets us avoid coupling runtime to legacy shapes. Downsides: extra hop, more moving parts on the edge fleet.

kai: Runtime shim keeps latency tighter and avoids duplicating parsing logic, but it couples the runtime to many legacy formats and makes KV/prefix cache semantics harder. Testing burden goes up.

nora: My leaning is edge-first + runtime fallback. Edge does shape-normalization and header canonicalization; runtime only does recovery for truly unexpected inputs. Telemetry must be per-cohort.

amanda: Agreed. Proposed guardrails: 1) tenant-level feature flag 2) shim transformations are non-destructive/idempotent 3) short cache TTLs for any normalized payload 4) automated regression alerts. Example flag: `cohorts.slim_api_shim = \"edge\"`

josh: Also need an escape hatch for urgent fixes — a runtime 'fallback' toggle deployable without a full client rollout (fast flip).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: runtime-fallback patch available in canary; use `/deploy patch runtime-fallback=true --cohort=canary`

kai: Perf note: edge adapter should do lightweight validation + mapping only, avoid heavy canonicalization. If we must transform, keep a checksum so runtime can detect transformed vs original.

nora: Obs plan: emit `shim.unexpected_shape` stream with shape fingerprint + tenant, surface top-10 shapes hourly. Alert if >1% error rate per tenant or if unknown shapes exceed threshold.

amanda: Rollout plan: create opt-in pilot cohort ~100 tenants for 48h, measure p50/p95 latency and error delta, then expand x10 increments. Rollback plan: flip cohort flag to 'off' and disable runtime fallback.

josh: I'll draft the runbook and the quick harness for simulating malformed/migrated payloads.

kai: I'll add integration tests asserting the runtime fallback preserves canonical request identity (no mutation) and doesn't widen cache keys.

nora: I'll wire dashboards: throughput, p50/p95, shim-errors, unknown-shape-rate, per-tenant delta. Also add an SLO guardrail for rollout.

amanda: Action items captured: josh (runbook + harness), kai (CI tests), nora (dashboards + alerts). Sync tomorrow 10:00am. @josh @kai @nora please drop any objections here. :thumbsup:
